spans.text: Based on previous findings in patients dependent on other substances we hypothesized that: (1) opioid-dependent subjects show increased activation of meso-corticolimbic regions compared to control subjects during heroin related cue-exposure; (2) control subjects show increased activation of meso-corticolimbic regions compared to opioid-dependent subjects for pleasant stimuli; whereas; (3) we did not expect groups to differ in reactivity to neutral stimuli, relative to baseline.
